market_question: Andy Burnham out as Mayor of Greater Manchester by May 31?
reasoning: Andy Burnham was re-elected in 2024 for a term ending 2028, and there is no indication he will resign, be removed, or otherwise cease being mayor before May 2026. There are no credible reports or rumours of impending resignation, scandal, or removal.
